entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with VeloFit support, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I think... I think I need to return it.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you help me understand what's going on with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's not broken, I just find it so... confusing. It feels really hard to use, and I honestly expected more from the display. I've read the user manual a couple of times and I still can't get the hang of it.
I see. I appreciate you clarifying that for me. Can I get your order number so I can pull up your account details and check the policy?

Of course. It's VF88602. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was so excited for this. It's just really disappointing, and to be honest, I really needed this money for some bills this month. I was counting on it working out.

Thank you for that, and I completely understand your position. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered on January 5th, so about 12 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. I hope that's not too late.
Not at all. I'm just checking our knowledge base... and yes, according to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can send it back for a full refund?

Absolutely. I have just authorized the return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed.
Wow. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been incredibly helpful. I really appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
